legend: There are N$$$N$$$ monsters on a two-dimensional plane. Each monster has a value associated with it.
A sword strike is an action that slays all monsters along a line. If you slay a monster, the monster disappears. The line must be parallel to one of the coordinate axes.
Compute the maximum sum of values of monsters that you can slay given that you can perform up to three sword strikes.
input: In the first line, a single integer N$$$N$$$ is given (1≤N≤300000$$$ 1 \leq N \leq 300\,000 $$$). Each of the next N$$$N$$$ lines contains three integers x,y,v$$$x, y, v$$$, indicating there is a monster located at (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ with value v$$$v$$$ (0≤x,y≤1000000$$$0 \leq x, y \leq 1\,000\,000$$$, 1≤v≤7000$$$1 \leq v \leq 7\,000$$$).
All monsters are at distinct locations.
output: Output the maximum sum of values of monsters that you can slay given that you can perform up to three sword strikes.

legend.ai: 在二维平面上有 N$$$N$$$ 个怪物。每个怪物都有一个与之关联的价值。
一次剑击是一种消灭一条直线上的所有怪物的操作。如果你消灭了某个怪物，该怪物就会消失。这条直线必须平行于某个坐标轴。
在你最多可以进行三次剑击的情况下，计算你能够消灭的怪物的价值总和的最大值。

input.ai: 所有怪物的位置均不相同。

output.ai: 输出在你最多可以进行三次剑击的情况下，能够消灭的怪物的价值总和的最大值。
